transformed_hypotheses.name: MULTI_LAYER_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Release evidence is not one hash. Semantic identity, exact byte identity, producer/build/input provenance and admission/authority identity must be separately bound or explicitly bridged by equivalence evidence before a candidate receipt can count as current release evidence.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: Post-R4 V18 reached strict 85/85 G9+Dialect and production/standalone AST-byte parity as a candidate, yet formal promotion remained blocked because exact current committed bytes did not durably execute on the required Ubuntu lane. The failure is therefore evidence-identity, not merely parser correctness.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Canonical semantic hash/parity alone is sufficient and the extra identities are redundant.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Hold canonical semantics constant while changing committed bytes, selected surface or build inputs; if current release acceptance remains sound without explicit provenance/equivalence binding across adversarial replay, the stronger tuple is unnecessary.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Durable content-addressed exact-current-byte Ubuntu replay plus same-semantic/different-surface equivalence canary and stale-receipt rejection.

transformed_hypotheses.name: MEASURED_CAUSAL_REWARD_SUBSPACE_BASELINE
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Historical reward preservation must target the measured causal reward subspace actually invoked and propagated into state/reentry, not a one-to-one copy of every named NAcc channel. A typed or multihorizon successor is selected only if it beats both the measured historical function and a simpler scalar causal-outcome baseline.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: Static archaeology found documentation drift (9 claimed versus 16 defined channel names) and sparse exact runtime call candidates while explicitly leaving indirect/dynamic runtime use UNKNOWN. This makes channel-name count an invalid baseline proxy.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Static search undercounts runtime dispatch and most named channels have distinct causal functions that a compressed successor would erase.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: H1 instrumentation observes broad distinct channel activation with differential downstream E-PQ/reentry effects that are lost by the reduced/typed successor.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Instrument reward invocation caller/channel/outcome provenance/phasic-tonic state/E-PQ delta/reentry on frozen traces and autonomous paths, then run historical-vs-scalar-vs-typed-vs-multihorizon matched factorial.

transformed_hypotheses.name: COMPLETENESS_GATED_ADAPTIVE_LIVE_FUSION
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Live cross-worker fusion should adapt between TARGETED_DELTA, DENSE_FANOUT and DIGEST_ONLY using current dependency span, multi-view projection-completeness confidence and measured cost. High-impact invalidations require zero permanent missed recipients after reconciliation; incomplete routing views must trigger anti-entropy, an independent second view, dense fallback or explicit DEGRADED_COORDINATION rather than silent targeted routing.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: The original 5,000-delta missing-edge falsifier reduced full payloads versus broadcast but missed 603 required deliveries at 8% hidden edges. A late independent candidate using the union of ClayGraph and UnifiedDB routing views plus reconciliation reached 0.9970 hot-path affected recall and 1.0 eventual synthetic recall, but required 8.034 send attempts/event versus 9.0 broadcast: correctness improved while the modeled transport saving shrank to ~10.7%. This strengthens adaptive multi-view repair and simultaneously strengthens the cost counterhypothesis.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Broadcast is simpler and dominates once dual-view reconciliation, anti-entropy, durability and real dense topology are counted.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Real repository replay shows no material latency/byte/resource gain at equal correctness, any permanent high-impact miss/stale effect after repair, or coordination overhead that dominates benefit.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Execute one converged real-repo broadcast/tag-only/adaptive lane with ClayGraph+UnifiedDB disagreement, missing/stale edge, duplicate, causal-reorder, crash/restart and Git-fallback faults; measure permanent miss rate, repair latency, false interrupts, payload/control bytes and resources.

transformed_hypotheses.name: ORIGIN_ARRIVAL_PROJECTION_REENTRY_WITH_OBSERVER_PASSIVITY
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Reentry must preserve authoritative causal-origin event identity/time, arrival/current-application time and projection derivation identity separately. Effectivized projection deltas cannot replace the raw event cursor. The observer/reentry mechanism is acceptable only if it is causally passive within resource/reliability budgets or isolated so it cannot materially perturb the authoritative writer.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: Post-R4 work connected dual-time feedback to the raw event plane and exposed observer backaction as a new failure mode. SQLite's official WAL/checkpoint semantics make same-file interference empirically plausible rather than merely theoretical.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Same-file observation is harmless at project load and isolation complexity is worse than any contention.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Matched workload shows same-file observer has no material writer-tail/retry/WAL/checkpoint regression and equal recovery semantics versus isolated/no-observer paths.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: No-observer vs same-file vs isolated observer factorial with p50/p95/p99 writer latency, SQLITE_BUSY/retries, WAL bytes, checkpoint latency, crash/restart, ABA and delayed/out-of-order feedback controls.

transformed_hypotheses.name: CAUSAL_RECEIPT_DURABILITY_WITH_MEASURED_COMMIT_POLICY
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Causal delivery/replan/effect receipts require durable semantics, but per-record fsync is an implementation choice rather than semantic law. Group/transaction commit is admissible only if crash/power-loss-surrogate tests preserve the receipt contract, replay equivalence and no unobservable delivered-but-not-durable window while materially improving latency/resources.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: A late local candidate microbenchmark measured strict locked per-record fsync mean cost ~111.84x buffered append. A selective-sync shadow was ~2.714x faster than strict-all-receipts and replayed 250/250 deltas plus 500/500 deliveries, but was NOT_SELECTED because replay equivalence alone does not prove immediate durability or power-loss safety.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Every causal receipt must be individually fsynced immediately; batching creates an unacceptable audit gap and any speed gain is irrelevant.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: A transaction/group-commit design reproduces latency benefit while process-crash, torn-tail and power-loss-surrogate tests show no loss of required causal receipts, no duplicate/stale effect and 100% authoritative fallback replay equivalence.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched Hostinger Ubuntu strict-per-record vs UnifiedDB transaction/group-commit factorial with p50/p95/p99, CPU/RSS/I/O, crash/torn-tail/power-loss surrogate, observer-backaction and effect-idempotency receipts.

fusion2_meta_invariant: An optimization may erase or batch structure only after semantic/causal/temporal/evidence identity is preserved, recipient-completeness failure is bounded and repaired, receiver/effect closure remains observable, and observer/control/durability mechanisms pass measured backaction and recovery gates.
